summary: Handoff is complete: PLAN.md, TEST_PLAN.md and NAMES.md are written alongside DESIGN.md. 11 phases (Phase 0 is yours — pips, skeleton, animations — and it blocks everything), 44 steps, 136 planned tests with fixtures fixed in advance, and every identifier registered. The audit gate that matters is clean: PLAN §1 has 5 normative blocks and 0 unauthorised, meaning every contract in it traces to a question you already answered — there is nothing in §1 for you to read. Two residual findings, reported rather than hidden. 'uncontracted 26' means 26 contract questions are specified in §1 as prose and tables rather than as fenced blocks; the checker only counts fences. That is a completeness note, not a decision leak. 'unquoted 11' has two false positives on PLAN.md (Q5's note is the two-character string '52', and Q213's note IS quoted verbatim at line 607) and nine genuine ones in DESIGN.md where the design paraphrases its own free-text answers — worth fixing since the design is the authority, and I can do that on request. Scope recommendation: Phases 1-4 and 8 are pure logic with hard gates and run together at low effort; Phases 5-7 are visual and need their own run at higher effort against a preview; Phase 9 (goal-curve refit) and Phase 10 (docs) are each their own run. Nothing is blocked on you except Phase 0 and the confirm.
